title: CPSC, Dell Computer Corp. Announce Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries
summary: These batteries can overcharge, causing them to become very hot, release smoke, and possibly catch fire. Units: About 284,000.

title: CPSC, Dynacraft Announce Recall of Mountain Bicycles Sold at Toys R Us
summary: The pedals on these bicycles can loosen and fall off while riding, resulting in serious injury to the rider. Units: About 54,000.

title: CPSC, Sheico PKS Inc. Announce Recall of Scuba Buoyancy Compensator Devices (BCDs)
summary: The overpressure valve can stick in the open position, presenting a drowning hazard to divers. Units: About 10,000.

title: CPSC, Harbor Freight Tools Announce Recall Propane Torches
summary: The hose that comes with the propane torch can crack or burst, presenting a fire and explosion hazard. Units: About 500.

title: CPSC, Tools Exchange Inc. Announce Recall of Novelty Cigarette Lighters
summary: The lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms, as required by federal law. Young children could ignite the lighters, presenting fire and burn hazards. Units: About 5,300.

title: CPSC, NHTSA, Evenflo Announce Recall to Repair Evenflo® Joyride® Car Seats/Carriers
summary: When the seat is used as an infant carrier, the handle can unexpectedly release, causing the seat to flip forward. When this happens, an infant inside the carrier can fall to the ground and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 3.4 million.

title: CPSC, BSH Home Appliances Corp.Announce Recall of Thermal/Microwave Ovens
summary: The oven door may not lock properly when the oven is put into the "self clean" mode. While the oven is in "self clean" mode, intense heat is generated to clean the oven. title: CPSC, Child Craft Industries Announce Recall of Changing Tables
summary: Some changing table joints were not properly glued and can separate, presenting a fall hazard to babies. Units: About 4,300.

title: CPSC, COMBI International Corp. Announce Recall of Activity Rockers
summary: One of the toys, a clear plastic ball, can crack and break during use, exposing the small beads inside, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 4,100.

title: CPSC, Sears Announce Recall of Glue Gun
summary: These glue guns can overheat, presenting fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 33,000.

title: CPSC, Canon U.S.A. Inc. Announce Recall of Fax Machines
summary: The Faxphones are combination plain-paper copiers and facsimile machines. A component failure can cause the Faxphone to catch on fire. Units: About 60,000.

title: CPSC, Drinkmaker of Sweden AB Announce Recall of Home Soda Machines
summary: Components inside the soda machine can break apart, posing a serious risk of lacerations to consumers, who can be struck by shrapnel. Units: About 4,000.

title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Basketball Sets
summary: Some of the nets have enlarged openings. If children put their heads into these enlarged openings, the net can get tangled around their necks and they could strangle. Units: About 55,000.

title: CPSC, Power Tool Manufacturers Announce Recall of Electric Drills
summary: The switches on these power tools, which were manufactured by Eaton Corp., of Cleveland, Ohio, can stick. The drills can continue to operate after the trigger is released, posing a risk of injury to consumers. Units: About 58,000.

title: CPSC, Unilever Home and Personal Care USA Announce Recall of Snuggle® Teeny Bean Bears Included with Fabric Softener
summary: The yellow pom-pom can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 150,000.

title: CPSC, Maytag Announce Recall of Electric Ranges
summary: Liquid can enter the indicator light and can cause sparking and flaming in the light, presenting a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 13,000.

title: CPSC, Sturm, Ruger & Company, Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Padlocks and Cable Gun Locks
summary: The padlocks can be opened using keys other than those originally provided with the locks and the cable locks can be opened if struck with force, potentially allowing unauthorized access to a firearm. Units: 1.2 million.

title: CPSC, Vermont Castings, Majestic Products Announce Recall of Space Heaters
summary: Overheating inside the space heaters can cause the exterior to become extremely hot, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 3,900.

title: CPSC, Saks Incorporated Announce Recall of Boys' Vests
summary: The elastic toggle cord on the end of the zipper pulls can loosen and come off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 14,500.

title: CPSC, Garden Way Announce Recall of Trimmers/Mowers
summary: The trimmer heads, which control the cutting cords, can split and detach, posing a serious injury risk to consumers. Units: About 2,800.

title: CPSC, Giant Bicycle, Inc. Recall Giant Bicycle Forks
summary: The forks can break during use, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 2,400.

title: CPSC, Raymond Geddes & Co. Inc. Recall Push'n Pop Toys
summary: The balloon tongues and the cylinders holding the tongues on these toys can detach, which poses choking and aspiration hazards to young children. Units: About 6,500.

title: CPSC, Schottenstein and Value City Department Stores Recall Candles
summary: The candle flame can ignite the silver paint coating on the candle container, presenting a fire hazard. Units: About 10,800.

title: CPSC, Spin Master Toys Announce Recall of Water Rocket Toys
summary: The rockets, once propelled from the launcher, can fly rapidly in unpredictable directions, and can hit and injure children. Units: About 108,000.
